nodes.label:
Open SiteTrace. Use authentication / account work or select a
permitted operation from the authorized workspace.

Sign in / restore a session; read
feedback, or request a password
reset.

Verify Auth credentials / session.
For invitation or reset, set a
password and sign in again.

Build the permitted role workspace;
open the requested route / home.

Search people; choose edit access,
invitation / retry, or an enabled
development account.

Save role / account status, or call
the secured account service.

Show access / invitation status and
audit; unfinished jobs retain retry
identity.

Search / filter equipment; open its
profile, photo, status and history.

Fields, Office setup
and edit rules valid?

Download template; choose CSV /
XLSX, worksheet and mapped columns.

Validate every row; show errors and
the projected record count.

All rows valid and
batch confirmed?

Import atomically with a stable
operation ID; expand Individual
units; retain grouped Bulk.

Show imported Asset IDs; export
results CSV and refresh inventory.

Search authorized projects; open
project / equipment accountability.

Enter selected metadata /
assignment changes, or choose
archive / restore.

Selected change and
record version valid?

Save the selected change and
history; preserve equipment
assignments.

Display project, stage, equipment,
custody and recorded timeline.

Open construction stage, weighted
work areas and update history.

Enter a work update / milestone, or
a correction to a recorded update.

Save the update / correction and
weighted progress; retain earlier
history.

Display construction progress and
the permanent project timeline.

Choose eligible Individual Asset
IDs, assigned destination and
request dates.

Create the pending request; record
activity and notifications.

Track own request status, decision
and linked handover.

Open pending request; inspect
requester, project and exact
requested Asset IDs.

Show approved request. Custody is
unchanged until physical receipt.

Record rejection and required
reason; retain history and notify
the requester.

Browse compatible types, available
/ reserved units and assigned
projects.

Choose Individual type, quantity
(1-100), project and optional
purpose.

View request history, decision and
assigned permanent Asset IDs.

Open pending request; obtain
eligible assets and an allocation
suggestion.

Use the suggestion or select the
exact number of eligible physical
Asset IDs.

Recheck and reserve exact units
atomically; create the linked
approved movement request.

Display allocated Asset IDs and
linked request; release remains a
separate action.

Release / receipt
rather than field send?

Admin opens approved release; Tool
Handler enters an allowed classic
transfer; recipient opens a pending
handover.

Validate permitted release /
classic transfer, recipient, assets
and locks; create a pending
handover.

Recipient verifies every physical
Asset ID, tests condition and
records notes / evidence.

All exact items
received and tested?

Scan / enter eligible Individual
Asset IDs in own custody; choose
recipient and their project.

Add transfer notes and optional
photographs for the selected
assets.

Submit pending transfer; the sender
remains accountable until
acceptance.

Named recipient opens Accept
equipment; physically receives and
tests every listed unit.

Every item physically
received and tested?

Retain custody / pending status.
Use permitted refusal or sender
cancel / reopen; record follow-up.

Scan / select exact Individual
Asset IDs in own eligible custody.

Choose configured Office; add
return notes and optional evidence
photographs.

Create inspection batch and
movement locks; retain original
custodian accountability.

Track pending / missing / disputed
findings until physical receipt is
verified.

Open return batch; inspect each
physical Asset ID and its evidence.

Record Good / Damaged / Missing /
Disputed, physical receipt and
required notes.

Good -> Office / available; Damaged
-> Office / repair. Clear holder
only for accepted items.

Retain custody / reservations for
unresolved items; save inspector
and evidence.

Show completed batch and permanent
inspection / asset history.

Custodian records damaged
equipment, fault details and
relevant notes.

Create repair case; equipment
becomes unavailable for requests.

Admin reviews fault / case; starts
repair and records completion notes
/ destination.

Record completed repair; return
asset to Available at the selected
site.

Custodian records missing
equipment, last known place and
circumstances.

Create missing case; mark
unavailable and retain
accountability.

Admin records actual recovery,
inspected condition, destination
and notes.

Recovery valid for
this open case?

Good -> Available; Damaged ->
repair case. Preserve recovery and
custody history.

Select eligible unheld Individual
asset; enter Sold / Disposed,
reason, date and evidence.

Save proposed retirement; notify
Admins; retain permanent Asset ID
and history.

A different active Admin reviews
the proposal, evidence and current
asset eligibility.

Recheck eligibility; record
approval; mark asset retired /
unavailable.

View permitted sold / disposed
history; record an issue report
when needed.

Enter supplier, reference, date,
lines / totals and optional
procurement link.

Optionally select a private PDF /
image purchase receipt.

Save ledger entry and change
history; purchase recording does
not receive stock.

View authorized purchase / receipt
access, history and purchase PDF.

Record rejection and decision
notes; keep the proposal history
without retiring the asset.

View category / SKU /
specification, stock balance,
minimum and history.

Choose catalog edit, stock usage /
restock / count correction, or
archive / restore.

Save only the selected action and
stock / archive history; protect
units and open obligations.

Display current balance, low-stock
status and retained transaction
history.

Choose item and quantity; enter
requester, needed date and
procurement purpose.

Valid with no
conflicting open request?

Create procurement request;
available stock is unchanged.

Record actual delivered quantity
and required delivery reference /
notes.

Receive stock atomically; update
quantity and history; retain
Partial until fully received.

Choose assigned project, material
items, units / quantities and
optional purpose.

View review decision, approved /
issued quantities and own issuance
history.

Open request; review quantities,
project and requester
accountability.

Save approved quantities; approval
alone does not deduct stock.

Enter quantities physically issued
now; approved remainder may be
issued later.

Deduct stock atomically; retain
issue history; mark Partial or
Issued.

View dated issuance analytics /
accountability; export CSV.
Consumption stays separate.

View role-scoped dashboard, search,
activity and own notifications /
overdue records.

Open permitted records; mark own
notices read; refresh authorized
data.

Select current inventory, saved
snapshot or activity, with a valid
reporting period.

Preview / export the permitted
report PDF. Historical inventory
uses saved snapshots.

View identity / theme. Failed
session / profile revalidation
closes the workspace to sign-in.

Clear workspace / listeners;
request local Auth sign-out.

Show signed-out sign-in screen and
relevant feedback.

Choose Admin / Engineer / Architect
sample; use browser-only demo
records.

Exit demo; clear demo role /
workspace, retain sample records
and show sign-in.
